summary: Non-static spherical midisuperspace: transforms conformally-flat isotropic initial data to areal (Misner-Sharp) coordinates, checks Einstein Hamiltonian constraint residual, and identifies R, m as relational variables that remain valid beyond the static Killing assumption.
